other_conditions: Child must be a ward/child of a building and other construction (BoC) worker who is a registered beneficiary of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The beneficiary must have completed at least one year as a registered beneficiary under the Board
A maximum of two children per family are eligible for assistance
For classes 6th and 7th, assistance is only for girl children; from class 8th onward, both girls and boys are eligible
Both parents cannot claim separate assistance for the same child if both are registered beneficiaries
The beneficiary must have made up‑to‑date annual contributions to the Board
The student must have at least 50 % attendance in the class for the academic year
The beneficiary must have an active bank account with DBT enabled in his/her name
benefits_summary: Annual educational assistance ranging from ₹2,000 to ₹40,000 per student, with an extra 20 % benefit for girl children from class 8 onward.
